revision_note: Targeted gap-successor sweep added: scope-specific closure, obstruction, open-input and unresolved-search dispositions. Prior software/native composition, clocks, Coulomb, radar and topological fragments are reused without physical promotion.

prior_research_audit.successor_policy: Consult located successors before treating predecessor next-action prose as current; fixed-lattice constructions and conditional models are not automatic tower-domain bindings.

operator_stimulus: Add an explicit target-coverage layer for the physical laws we intend to connect to the tower, separating constants and spectra from laws.
scope_policy: These are intended target families, not a theorem that every known law has been enumerated. Each needs a frozen regime and structure-preserving tower comparison before an executable attempt. This catalogue neither replaces the central programme nor changes its target-selection authority.
coverage_policy: Prior evidence is indexed at its original scope. A symmetry, conditional model, retained encoding or imported law alone does not establish physical-domain coverage. Supplied physical parameters are permitted if explicit; source selection and faithful representation are distinct claims.
scheduling_policy: Inventory only. No target is automatically executable, selected or a new dependency of the governing conjecture. Hardware/acquisition remain outside this update.

structural_obligations.policy: The matrix records initial applicability, not theorem dependencies or completed proofs. Listed targets require this structure when freezing their named regime; unlisted pairs remain unassessed, not inapplicable. Applicability may be refined only with an explicit regime and reason. No obligation is made universal by this inventory.

entries.structure: Physical coarse-graining, effective dynamics, renormalization, continuum and thermodynamic limits, and classical limits where the target requires them.
entries.required_comparison: Specify the physical scale/cutoff maps, retained observables, effective laws and convergence topology; compare these with admitted tower operations rather than identifying serialization order with scale.
entries.failure_witness: Two admitted cutoff/refinement routes disagree on a required limiting observable, or eliminated variables change dynamics claimed autonomous at the effective level.
entries.evidence_boundary: The finite Hamiltonian factorization gate and the separate action-level renormalization analysis are clues from distinct sources, not a general RG or continuum theorem.

entries.structure: Local observable algebras, subsystem composition, causal commutation, constrained factorization and gluing across overlapping regions.
entries.required_comparison: Preserve localization, allowed subsystem operations and overlap/gluing laws on the same source; declare gauge constraints and any nonfactorizing observable structure.
entries.failure_witness: A globally invertible encoding fails a required local-operation square, erases a causal distinction or assumes an inadmissible tensor factorization.
entries.evidence_boundary: The conditional optical assembly supplies scoped overlap/domain controls, not locality or composition for every physical domain.

entries.structure: Parity, time reversal, charge conjugation and their products; unitary versus antiunitary implementation, projective phases, central extensions and explicitly broken symmetries.
entries.required_comparison: Bind each target transformation, its composition/square law, sector action and conjugate-linearity to a source operation. State whether it is an actual symmetry, a covariance relation or a broken transformation.
entries.failure_witness: A cycle inverse is labelled charge conjugation while preserving a required nonzero charge, or a unitary/antiunitary or projective composition law fails.
entries.evidence_boundary: The existing cycle-reversal and charge-sector obstruction is scoped; the complex-linear atlas explicitly does not classify antiunitaries. No physical C, P, T or CPT theorem is imported.

entries.structure: Bundle topology, holonomy and flux sectors, defects, superselection structure, line/surface observables and higher-form symmetries in targets carrying them.
entries.required_comparison: Retain global transition/sector data and the algebra and transport of extended observables, not only local fields or curvature values.
entries.failure_witness: Equivalent proposed cuts identify sectors or holonomies that a required loop, surface or defect observable distinguishes.
entries.evidence_boundary: Rank-one Berry examples and a finite cochain model provide bounded precedents; neither establishes general global-sector coverage.

entries.structure: Boundary/initial conditions, boundary flux and edge modes, asymptotic states and charges, soft relations and memory where present.
entries.required_comparison: Specify the admitted boundary/asymptotic regime and preserve its state, flux, reference and observable maps along the tower comparison; bulk equations do not select these data.
entries.failure_witness: The proposed cut preserves bulk equations but loses an allowed boundary charge, environmental flux, incoming/outgoing distinction or memory observable.
entries.evidence_boundary: Finite relative orientation and retained environment models are prior examples, not a derived BMS, soft-theorem or arbitrary-boundary result.

targets.law_domain: Newtonian, Lagrangian and Hamiltonian mechanics: states, forces, variational equations, free flight, interactions and constrained motion in specified finite-dimensional regimes.
supplied_assumptions: canonical chart and declared interaction pulses
targets.missing_comparison: Bind independently specified mechanical domains, including free flight and admissible forces, to admitted tower cuts; do not promote a constrained six-pulse embedding to all mechanics.

targets.law_domain: Energy, momentum, angular momentum and charge conservation; Noether relations between continuous symmetries, actions and currents, including boundary flux.
targets.missing_comparison: Identify the source action, symmetry generators, conserved charges/currents and boundary terms on the same domain. Distinguish conserved quadratic budget from pulse energy and physical energy.

targets.law_domain: Maxwell equations, Gauss constraints, conserved electric current, Lorentz force, field propagation and Coulomb/radiative regimes.
targets.prior_work_disposition: Conditional continuum Coulomb binding and source-labelled oscillator protocols exist. One-bridge finite electric energy is separable; physical field/current selection is not supplied by those constructions.
supplied_assumptions: endpoint phase representation and transported metric
optical laws in existing optical models
charge, clock and energy units where used
targets.missing_comparison: Construct a common field/current domain with gauge constraints and dynamics, then a tower-cut comparison preserving it. Phase covariance alone supplies neither curvature dynamics nor an electromagnetic coupling.

targets.law_domain: Quantum state and observable spaces, Schrodinger/unitary evolution, canonical commutation structure and declared operator domains.
targets.missing_comparison: Extend the bounded native unitary/canonical realizations to independently specified quantum domains, retaining operator-domain and completion obligations. Full U(n) availability is not selection of a physical Hamiltonian.

targets.law_domain: Born probabilities, instruments, state update, open-system channels, loss/noise and complete sequential measurement records.
symmetries: representation changes preserving complete instrument laws
supplied_assumptions: positive state/effect pairing and CP instrument laws in current models
targets.missing_comparison: Supply a tower-to-instrument comparison preserving probabilities, posterior states and future interventions, with imported measurement laws distinguished from source-derived laws. Finite classical records need not determine coherent completion.

targets.law_domain: Composite systems, entanglement and Bell correlations, identical-particle exchange, Bose/Fermi statistics and spin-statistics under specified relativistic/locality assumptions.
supplied_assumptions: Fock or spinor factors where used
locality and relativistic assumptions when invoking spin-statistics
targets.missing_comparison: Identify physical composition, exchange and spin sectors through the same tower source. A permutation group, tensor probe or added spinor factor alone does not derive particle statistics or a Bell experiment.

targets.law_domain: Lorentzian spacetime, causal propagation, relativistic kinematics and energy-momentum relations.
supplied_assumptions: a target causal/spacetime structure and physical units must be specified
targets.missing_comparison: Construct an admitted tower realization carrying Lorentzian signature, causal structure and the physical Poincare action. Positive field-metric automorphisms and finite tetrahedral rotations do not supply this identification.

targets.law_domain: Einstein field equations, diffeomorphism constraints, gravitational propagation and specified boundary/asymptotic regimes.
symmetries: asymptotic symmetry actions under declared boundary conditions
targets.prior_work_disposition: An ideal radar observation/completion chain and later native finite admission/output-enclosure proofs exist for supplied vacuum sources. They do not derive Einstein dynamics or identify finite radar-shape readings with pointwise curvature.
supplied_assumptions: field phase space, action and boundary conditions
targets.missing_comparison: Provide field constraints and their Poisson algebra, a continuum geometric domain and a tower comparison. A finite cotangent lift does not supply GR; withdrawn legacy ADM/continuum promotions are not reinstated.

targets.law_domain: Equilibrium/Gibbs states, detailed balance and KMS, fluctuation-dissipation, entropy and the second law, and specified nonequilibrium transport regimes.
symmetries: time reversal and its stated breaking
targets.missing_comparison: Preserve cross-frequency thermal coherence, preparation and the relevant fluctuation/response or entropy structure. Occupation recovery and a finite KMS ratio test are not full thermal-domain coverage.

targets.law_domain: QCD/Yang-Mills matter and gauge dynamics, non-Abelian constraints, strong-interaction scattering and specified confinement/hadronic regimes.
symmetries: flavour/chiral symmetries with explicit breaking and anomalies
supplied_assumptions: action, coupling, regulator and scale conventions
targets.missing_comparison: Bind non-Abelian field/current dynamics and physical observables to a tower cut. A U(3) factor in a mathematical commutant does not identify colour or derive QCD. Sector-specific prior work still needs a dedicated source/successor audit.

targets.law_domain: Chiral SU(2) x U(1) gauge/matter dynamics, symmetry breaking, charged and neutral currents and anomaly cancellation.
supplied_assumptions: chiral matter content and gauge charges
targets.missing_comparison: Identify the physical fields, representations, constraints and interactions on one admitted source. Internal U(1) x U(2) automorphisms and finite inflow records are not an electroweak derivation.

targets.law_domain: Scalar, spinor and vector field equations; interaction vertices, scattering amplitudes, unitarity, crossing and causality in frozen regimes.
symmetries: crossing and discrete symmetry relations where applicable
supplied_assumptions: kinetic terms, couplings and boundary/asymptotic states
targets.missing_comparison: Recover independently specified field and scattering domains while retaining kinetic, interaction and observable structure. Reuse the central scattering target without treating formal quarticity as a complete physical vertex derivation.

targets.law_domain: Berry transport, holonomy, topological response and anomaly inflow in specified bundle, gap and boundary regimes.
targets.missing_comparison: Extend the existing scoped rank-one Berry and finite relational-inflow comparisons only through independently admitted sources; arbitrary bundles, non-Abelian transport and full QFT anomalies remain distinct targets.

targets.law_domain: Fluid mechanics, elasticity, diffusion and transport: continuum balance equations, stress/current fields, constitutive laws and initial/boundary-value problems in specified regimes.
symmetries: Galilean or relativistic covariance as appropriate
targets.prior_work_disposition: Existing regularity microprogramme located, not a completed continuum-law derivation. No completed general constitutive-law tower binding was found in this bounded audit; global absence is not claimed.
targets.missing_comparison: Bind fields, constitutive response, balance laws and dissipative evolution to an admitted tower cut. Finite mechanics and equilibrium thermal identities do not establish these continuum laws; a dedicated sector-source audit remains needed.

targets.law_domain: Many-body phases, order parameters, spontaneous symmetry breaking, collective excitations, phase transitions, critical scaling and universality in specified thermodynamic regimes.
symmetries: emergent and generalized symmetry actions where present
targets.prior_work_disposition: Reuse the conditional local/phase reconstruction hierarchy, finite D(S3) result and fixed-lattice form construction; none closes arbitrary phase transitions, universality or tower binding.
supplied_assumptions: many-body interactions, state and order-parameter algebra
targets.missing_comparison: Represent the phase distinctions and limiting operations, not just a finite symmetry group or spectrum. Prove any claimed emergence, breaking or critical behaviour in the frozen target; dedicated source and successor audits remain needed.

targets.law_domain: Kinetic equations, stochastic processes, collision/transition laws, memory-dependent evolution and their relation to irreversible macroscopic dynamics.
symmetries: probability normalization and specified conservation laws
targets.prior_work_disposition: Fixed-lattice paths, densities/entropy, strong solutions, same-noise transport and R3/R4 conditional audit expansions already have written constructions. Do not restart those tasks; independent analytic review and physical/tower comparison remain separate.
supplied_assumptions: collision/noise kernels and Markov or memory assumptions
targets.missing_comparison: Preserve trajectory laws, intervention/conditioning structure and memory under the same tower comparison. A Gibbs state or finite instrument marginal does not determine the process or justify kinetic closure; audit sector priors before proposing a test.

targets.law_domain: Measured dimensionless couplings, their scale dependence and candidate integer-plus-correction explanations, including low-energy inverse fine-structure coupling.
supplied_assumptions: physical reference channel and kinetic/current normalization
targets.missing_comparison: Bind leaf counting and any residual correction to physical response without fitting the target. The 137-leaf identification, 144-minus-7 reversibility mechanism and quartic tail are separate open claims; previous failed precision models remain failures.

targets.law_domain: Particle masses and mixing, atomic/nuclear spectra, binding energies, stability and decay predictions in specified sectors.
supplied_assumptions: energy normalization, preparation and boundary conditions
targets.missing_comparison: Bind mathematical spectra and candidate geometries to actual particles and common physical energy units, then predict spectra/binding/decay. Counts, finite mode energies and spinor extensions alone do not establish those predictions; dedicated sector audits remain needed.

targets.law_domain: Expansion histories, cosmological response and parameter predictions in specified gravitational/matter/background regimes.
symmetries: specified background homogeneity/isotropy and perturbative symmetry
targets.missing_comparison: Audit existing cosmology sources and bind their domains to the same admitted tower framework before inferring cosmological parameters from counts or residuals. No coverage result is imported here.
